home_tagline_body: A portfolio management lab with real Indonesian stock prices.
app_simulation_notice: Simulation. No real money and no real trades.
language_unknown_error: The form sent "{value}" in the field {field}, but Portolab is only available in Bahasa Indonesia and English. Choose one of them in the language switch.
language_page_body: Choose a language with the switch at the top of the page.
language_rejected_title: The language could not be changed
language_not_text_error: The form sent a value of type {type} in the field {field} instead of text. Choose Bahasa Indonesia or English in the language switch.
language_missing_error: The form sent no language in the field {field}. Choose Bahasa Indonesia or English in the language switch.
app_not_found_body: This address does not exist in Portolab. Check the address again, or go back to the home page.
app_unexpected_error_body: Portolab could not show this page. Try reloading the page. If the problem continues, tell your lecturer.
market_data_delay_notice: Prices are delayed by about 10 minutes and come from Yahoo Finance. The latest price was recorded at {time} WIB.
market_data_empty_body: Portolab has no prices yet. It fetches them when the server starts, and then during trading hours.
market_data_update_failed_notice: Portolab could not update the prices at {time} WIB, so the prices below are the last ones it stored. Portolab tries again after longer and longer pauses.
market_data_empty_failed_body: Portolab has no prices yet, because its latest attempt to fetch them at {time} WIB failed. Portolab tries again after longer and longer pauses.
